title: 1-1 prep - Priya Shah
content:
1:1 prep with Aaron (manager) - Priya Shah
Date: 2026-03-03 (scheduled)
Duration: 30m

Goals for this 1:1:
- Quick sync on top priorities this week and next (what needs unblock now).
- Surface blockers I want help with (resourcing, stakeholder alignment).
- Career check-in / 6-month growth goals.
- Clarify expectations on on-call rotation changes and SLA targets.
- Agree concrete action items and owners.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick wins & wins since last 1:1 (5m)
   - Merged PR #1873: improved KV cache eviction thresholds for long-context models (profiling showed ~12% latency reduction in 2p tests).
   - Docs: updated runbook section for model-variant fallback behavior (linked above).

2) Current priorities / focus (8m)
   - Priority A: Get INF-342 (prefix caching for streaming) to staging and run perf baseline across dedicated pools. Blocker: need additional test GPU time; request 48 GPU-hours.
   - Priority B: Finish integration tests for auto-batching improvements (flaky failures on p99 observed).
   - Priority C: Mentorship + onboarding for new SWE intern (Sofia) \u2014 ramp plan and pairing schedule.

3) Blockers & asks (7m)
   - GPU quota: Who to contact to request a temporary quota bump for test cluster? (I tried infra-requests channel, ticket open but no reply).
   - Product alignment: Need product to confirm SLA fallback policy for dedicated customers \u2014 unclear if we should degrade to cheaper quantized model automatically. Suggested: can you escalate to PM?
   - Test flakiness: failing CI job 'serving-runtime/bench' on nightly runs. I suspect non-deterministic sequencing in test harness. Ask for time allocation from SRE/PT to investigate.

4) Career / growth (5m)
   - Progress on leadership goals: shipped technical design doc for cache refactor; wanting feedback on next steps to take more ownership (leading a small cross-team project).
   - Interest: more involvement in release engineering discussions and design reviews for deployment abstraction layer.

5) Action items / next steps (5m)
   - Confirm owner and ETA for GPU quota request escalation (owner: Aaron?)
   - Schedule 2-hour debugging deep-dive with SRE (owner: Priya; target: 2026-03-08)
   - Get PM decision on fallback policy and document agreed behavior (owner: Aaron; ask for intro to PM by EOD 2026-03-04)
   - Pairing plan for Sofia: draft schedule and first week tasks (owner: Priya; share by 2026-03-05)

Notes / talking points to mention:
- Share the perf numbers from PR #1873 (12% p50/p90 improvement in microbench). I can paste the table quickly in the chat during the 1:1.
- Explain risk tradeoffs for automatic fallback: cost savings vs quality/regression risk. Suggest conservative default (manual opt-in for dedicated customers).
- On on-call: prefer keeping current rotation but am open to shifting to every-8-weeks if we add a second person to rotation; need Aaron's support to recruit (identify candidate: Marcus?).

Draft follow-up items (to be converted to Jira tasks after the 1:1):
- INF-342: staging rollout + perf baseline (Priya) - target 2026-03-12
- INF-349: investigate nightly bench flakiness (Priya + SRE) - target 2026-03-10
- DOC-560: add SLA fallback decision and examples to customer-facing docs (Aaron/PM) - target 2026-03-15
- ONBOARD-12: Sofia pairing schedule + first-task checklist (Priya) - target 2026-03-05

Notes to self (private):
- Bring up bandwidth concerns: juggling infra requests + on-call + new intern ramp \u2014 need to be realistic about bandwidth and push for prioritization.
- Have specific ask ready for Aaron: "Can you back a temporary quota bump request and intro to infra lead?"
- Prepare short demo (3 slides/screenshare) showing before/after latency stats from PR #1873.

End of doc.
